items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I saw him play once in the Cooperator’s Hall... I saw him, but I never heard no more of him

ctx.x: Raddy Jean Vigne was the boss of the drummers downtown. Raddy Jean Vigne had a moustache, and he played like this when he played. That’s what Baby Dodds got that from. You ever see Baby Dodds?
